name: tabs
source: ui/components/Tabs/Tab.vue (MTab — wraps Ant a-tabs) + ui/components/Tabs/TabPane.vue (MTabPane). Persisted state: src/components/_base-persisted-tab.vue (MPersistedTab — renderless localStorage wrapper).
summary: In-page tabbed navigation that switches between sibling views of ONE page (Overview / Performance / Logs) — NOT between-page routing (obs-sidebar / obs-breadcrumbs). Data-driven: the tabs attr is a JSON array of {key,label,count?,icon?,disabled?} (or a simple "A,B,C" list); content goes in one named slot per key; only the active pane shows. Class-based variants via the variant attr: line (default) · no-border (drops the bar rule, 21x dominant) · sticky (pins the bar in a scroll pane) · grey (tinted bar). A label can carry a count ("Alerts (12)") or a leading obs-icon. persist-key remembers the active tab in localStorage across reloads. Selecting is reflow-free (the active weight-500 width is reserved). Active tab = --primary (text + 4px underline, weight 500); inactive = --tabs-text-color; bar rule = --border-color. Render-faithful to the product MTab/a-tabs (line/top/default only — Ant card/vertical/size are unused and intentionally not built).

variants.name: closable-addable
variants.what: an editable tab strip — closable (× per tab, only when >1) + addable (a + at the far right). Emits close/add.
variants.usage: the metric-explorer monitor tabs (obs-metric-picker) / any add-remove tab set

usage.alwaysLineTopDefault: No real <MTab> passes type=, position=, or size= — every usage is line / top / default.

labelPatterns.count-in-label: `Alerts (${count})`, `${tab.title} (${getCounts(tab)})` — count appended to the string, not a badge component
labelPatterns.icon-in-label: tab slot with a leading MIcon
labelPatterns.dynamic: v-for over a tabs config array (tab.text/key/name)

usage.tabBarExtraContent: 0x — the extra-content slot exists but is unused in the product

tabs.note: the tab set — a JSON array of {key,label,count?,icon?,disabled?} OR a simple comma list "Overview,Performance,Logs".

value.note: the active tab key; reflected onto the host (el.value) and emitted via `change` when a tab is clicked.

variant.note: class-based style (the product reality): line (default) · no-border (drops the bar rule, 21× dominant) · sticky (pins the bar in a scroll pane) · grey (tinted bar). Ant card/vertical/size are unused in-product and intentionally not built.

persist-key.note: persist the active tab in localStorage under `${persist-key}-tab` — it survives reload/navigation (the product MPersistedTab behaviour). Omit for non-persisted tabs.

closable.note: show a × on each tab (ONLY when there is more than one) → emits `close` {key}. For an editable tab strip like the metric-explorer monitor tabs.

addable.note: show a "+" button at the far RIGHT of the bar → emits `add`. Pair with `closable` for an add/remove tab strip.

slots.[key]:
one NAMED slot per tab key holds that pane’s content —
…
; only the active pane renders.
slots.MTab.tabBarExtraContent: right-aligned content on the tab bar (available, unused in product)
slots.MTabPane.tab: rich tab label (icon + text + count) — overrides the `tab` prop
slots.MPersistedTab.default: scoped slot receiving { tab, setTab } — wire to <MTab :value=tab @change=setTab>

decisionFlow: Switching between sibling VIEWS of the SAME page (Overview / Performance / Logs)? -> obs-tabs. For BETWEEN-page navigation use obs-sidebar (primary) or obs-breadcrumbs (trail), NOT tabs.
Tabs sitting on a card/panel that already has its own edges? -> variant="no-border" (the 21x dominant variant).
A long scrolling pane where the tab bar must stay visible? -> variant="sticky".
Tab bar on a plain surface that needs a tint? -> variant="grey".
A tab label needs a live count? -> put it on the tab: tabs=[{"label":"Alerts","count":12}] renders "Alerts (12)" (not a separate badge).
A tab needs a leading icon? -> add icon: {"label":"List","icon":"list"} (a product icon name; reuses obs-icon).
Data-driven tab set? -> pass the whole array to tabs (JSON) or a simple "A,B,C" list; add/remove by changing it.
Remember the user's last tab across reload / navigation? -> persist-key="<module>" (stores it in localStorage as <module>-tab).

An EDITABLE tab set — the user CREATES / CLOSES tabs at runtime (the metric-explorer monitor tabs, worksheet/query tabs)? -> `closable` (a × per tab, shown only when >1) + `addable` (a + at the far right); they emit `close` {key} / `add` for you to update the `tabs` array. (Card / vertical tabs remain unbuilt — the product doesn’t use them.)

line.useWhen: the default in-page tab strip — switching sibling sections of one page/entity.
line.dontUse: to navigate between routes -> obs-sidebar / obs-breadcrumbs.
line.example: Monitor detail: Overview / Performance / Logs / Configuration.

no-border.useWhen: the tabs sit inside a card/panel that already draws its own edges (the 21x dominant case).
no-border.dontUse: as a page-level tab strip that needs the separating rule.

sticky.useWhen: a long scrolling detail/settings pane where the tab bar must stay in view.

grey.useWhen: the tab bar sits on a plain background and needs a subtle tinted strip.

with-counts.useWhen: a tab names a collection whose size matters (correlated Alerts / Logs / Metrics).
with-counts.dontUse: a static section with no count.

with-icons.useWhen: tabs read better with a leading glyph (List / Grid / Topology views).

dynamic.useWhen: the tab set comes from data/config (widget editor: Attributes / Metric / Style / Sorting / Column Setting).
dynamic.dontUse: a fixed known set (still fine, just inline the array).
dynamic.example: bind tabs to your config array.

persisted.useWhen: a module-level tab set the user returns to — remember their last tab across reloads.
persisted.example: persist-key="monitors" -> restores from localStorage on mount.

closable-addable.useWhen: the user creates/removes tabs at runtime (monitor tabs, worksheet tabs)
closable-addable.dontUse: a fixed set of sibling views (plain tabs)
closable-addable.example: closable addable → × on each (when >1) + a + that emits add

do: Use for sibling views of the same context.
Use class='no-border' when the tabs sit on a card.
Append counts to the label string; keep labels short.
Build data-driven tab sets with v-for.
Use MPersistedTab where users return to a remembered tab.

Use `closable` + `addable` for an EDITABLE tab strip (e.g. the metric-explorer monitor tabs) — wire the `close` / `add` events to update your tab array; the × only shows when there is more than one tab.
dont: Don't use tabs to navigate between separate pages — that's routing.
Don’t reach for card / vertical tabs (still unbuilt — not in the product); the supported editable pattern is `closable` + `addable` on the line tabs.
Don't build a separate count badge — the product appends '(N)' to the label.
Don't rely on the tabBarExtraContent slot to match the product — it's unused there.
Don’t expect obs-tabs to add/remove tabs itself — it emits close/add; the `tabs` array is data-driven, so the parent updates it (see obs-metric-picker for a component that manages this).

F1.issue: Catalog-wide focus-ring removal (SF-001) can affect the tab triggers' :focus-visible outline; verify keyboard focus is visible on the active/!active tab.

editable.issue: Closable / addable are data-driven: obs-tabs emits `close` {key} / `add` but does NOT mutate its own tab set — the parent owns the `tabs` array and updates it (obs-metric-picker does this for the monitor tabs). A standalone static example therefore shows the × / + but won’t self-remove/add.

accessibility.providedByAnt: a-tabs renders role=tablist / role=tab / role=tabpanel, aria-selected on the active tab, and supports Left/Right arrow-key navigation between tabs.
accessibility.verify: Keyboard focus-visibility on tab triggers (SF-001); that a meaningful label is present for icon-only tabs.

events.change: (key) — the active tab changed (fired on click; also reflected to el.value).
events.MTab.change: (activeKey) — active tab changed; this is the v-model event (`:value.sync` ⇄ `@change`).
events.MPersistedTab: renderless — exposes { tab, setTab } via its scoped slot; wire setTab to MTab @change to persist the active tab.

a11y.summary: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel; active=aria-selected, disabled=aria-disabled; Left/Right arrows move, Enter/Space activate; Ant links tab↔panel via aria-controls. Closable: each × is a role=button with aria-label "Close tab" (emits close; does not switch tabs). Addable: the + is an obs-button with aria-label "Add" (emits add). Both are keyboard-reachable.
issues: Icon-only tabs need an accessible name.

issues.issue: The × (close) sits inside the tab button — ensure a click on it does not also switch to that tab (it calls stopPropagation) and that its aria-label conveys which tab it closes for screen-reader users.

a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.

value.note: the active key; v-model via @change (model event=change). 41x bind @change.

variant.note: applied as a CLASS on a-tabs (:class=[variant]). NOTE: in practice the product applies variant classes via plain class= (e.g. class='no-border'), not this prop — both land on the .ant-tabs root and behave identically.

size.note: UNUSED in product (no usage passes it)

position.note: tabPosition; UNUSED beyond 'top' (no vertical tabs in product)

tab.note: the tab label (string). For a rich label (icon/count markup) use the `tab` SLOT instead.

key.note: the pane's key — matches MTab value

forceRender.note: render pane content even when inactive

changelog: 2026-07-23 — Full doc pass for the closable/addable variant: playground gained Closable + Addable toggles; decisionFlow now routes the editable-tab-set case; a11y covers the × (close) / + (add) controls; do/dont + a knownIssue clarify that obs-tabs emits close/add while the parent owns the tab array.
2026-07-23 — Polish (owner): the addable + button is now obs-button size=small (~29×25, was the 35×35 squared) so it sits proportionate to the tab labels; keeps the 4px radius.
2026-07-23 — Reuse (owner): the addable "+" now REUSES obs-button (variant neutral-lightest, squared) instead of a hand-built button; the × / + glyphs already reuse obs-icon.

2026-07-23 — Added a closable + addable tab strip: `closable` shows a × per tab (only when >1 tab, emits close) and `addable` shows a + at the far right (emits add) — so an editable tab set (e.g. the metric-explorer monitor tabs) reuses obs-tabs instead of hand-rolling it.

changelog.change: Docs pass: element-centric summary (dropped the unused ink-bar wording; added variants/count/icon/persist-key/reflow-free); rewrote decisionFlow + usageRules in obs-tabs attribute syntax (was product MTab/MPersistedTab Vue); added the grey variant + persist-key. Playground gains Dynamic + persist-key.

Fixed the active↔inactive weight-change reflow (jerk) by reserving the bold-500 label width (invisible ::after ghost) — no layout shift on select, all variants. Added native persist-key (localStorage) for the Persisted variant, and explicit Dynamic (config-array) + Persisted gallery examples.

Added obs-tabs element — render-faithful line-style tabs (variants line/no-border/sticky/grey; count + icon labels; data-driven tabs + named-pane slots). diff.mjs ✅ MATCH (8 scenarios, light+dark); reuses obs-icon for tab icons. First of the Structure & Navigation page-structure set.
